issue_context.title: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS handles SQL like wild cards wrong
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
select table_schema, table_name, column_name from information_schema.columns where column_name like '%time';

I would assume this is similar for other information_schema tables and possibly other generated tables in TiDB.

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

Column names only ending with 'time'

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

All columns matching the regex pattern `(?i).*time` (without an ending '$')
Including column_name 'DATETIME_PRECISION', see below:

```
tidb> select table_schema, table_name, column_name from information_schema.columns where column_name like '%time';
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| table_schema       | table_name                                        | column_name                             |
+--------------------+---------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| INFORMATION_SCHEMA | STATEMENTS_SUMMARY_EVICTED                        | BEGIN_TIME                              |
| INFORMATION_SCHEMA | STATEMENTS_SUMMARY_EVICTED                        | END_TIME                                |
| INFORMATION_SCHEMA | DEADLOCKS                                         | OCCUR_TIME                              |
| INFORMATION_SCHEMA | PARAMETERS                                        | DATETIME_PRECISION                      |
```

```
tidb> explain select table_schema, table_name, column_name from information_schema.columns where column_name like '%time';
+----------------------+----------+------+---------------+----------------------------------+
| id                   | estRows  | task | access object | operator info                    |
+----------------------+----------+------+---------------+----------------------------------+
| Projection_4         | 10000.00 | root |               | Column#2, Column#3, Column#4     |
| └─MemTableScan_5     | 10000.00 | root | table:COLUMNS | column_name_pattern:[(?i).*time] |
+----------------------+----------+------+---------------+----------------------------------+
2 rows in set (0.01 sec)
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
```
Release Version: v5.5.0-alpha-288-g64f8c4756f
Edition: Community

Check Table Before Drop: false
```
comments:
This must be a fairly new change (found the issue in current master), since testing with tiup this version (5.4.0) is working as expected:
```
Release Version: v5.4.0
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 55f3b24c1c9f506bd652ef1d162283541e428872
Git Branch: heads/refs/tags/v5.4.0
UTC Build Time: 2022-01-25 08:39:26
GoVersion: go1.16.4
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false
```

I have known the reason. It happen here 

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/d101fc0c3211e9be28f136e99e1b1b0f7237c70e/planner/core/memtable_predicate_extractor.go#L269

it will change the regrax expression ```  %abc => .*abc```.

@mjonss Do you know why it needs to change the regrax expression in the origin?

if it is ```LIKE```, it will make ```%abc => .*abc```.
if it is ```Regexp``` , it will Keep it as it is.

Maybe all the ones that use ```helper.extractLikePattern```  have bugs?

review_comments: Not sure is this a good way. We can't get `case-insensitive` information from the plan right now.
In fact, We need case-insensitivity when to ```show``` executor. so we add case-insensitive push-down to the ```show```.
